newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady amid select buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady amid select buying.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates ended steady on Tuesday on select demand from mill owners and dealers said prices were likely to hover around the same levels until the new crop arrives in June.

"The arrival of the new crop is expected in the first week of June. Until then, the prices are likely to remain pegged at these levels," dealer Khushi Ram said. "Today there was some buying by mill owners."
In the kerb, NIAB-78 variety was quoted at around 1,900 rupees ($47.24) per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
